item.title: Niigata Onsen Guide: Echigo Yuzawa, Tsugaike & Snow Country Hot Springs
item.description: Niigata Prefecture Onsen & Hot Spring Guide for International Visitors Niigata Prefecture, positioned along the Japan Sea coast and blessed with heavy winter snowfall, offers some of Japan’s most atmospheric onsen experiences. The region’s hot springs combine dramatic mountain scenery, deep powder snow, and literary heritage into an unforgettable bathing culture that remains authentically Japanese despite increasing international awareness. 1. Echigo-Yuzawa Onsen (越後湯沢温泉): The Literary Snow Country Echigo-Yuzawa holds a special place in Japanese cultural consciousness thanks to Yasunari Kawabata’s 1948 Nobel Prize-winning novel “Snow Country” (雪国).
